newsitem.title: USA: MCI seeks arbitration in Connecticut.
newsitem.headline: MCI seeks arbitration in Connecticut.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp said on Monday it was seeking arbitration in negotiations with Southern New England Telecommunications Corp (SNET), over MCI's entry into local markets.
The company said in a statement it had filed an arbitration petition with Connecticut Department of Public Utility Control.
At issue is the inability of SNET and MCI to "resolve the critical issues concerning interconnection terms and resale discount rates," the statement said.
MCI offers facilities-based local service in Hartford as well as Atlanta, Baltimore, Boston, Chicago, Cleveland, Detroit, Milwaukee, New York, Philadelphia, Portland, Ore., Pittsburgh and Seattle.
